nodes.definition: Alert that a present signal in awareness is not yet determined knowledge.
nodes.programming_contract: EpistemicZero(zero_id, signal_ref, reason, awareness_present, knowledge_determined, residuals)
nodes.linguistic_function: Marks unknown presence and preserves it for governed processing.

nodes.definition: Selection of a specific epistemic-zero signal for active processing.
nodes.programming_contract: AttentionEvent(event_id, zero_id, selected_signal, salience_score, urgency_score, relevance_score, reason, residuals)
nodes.linguistic_function: Moves from generic alert to explicit processing commitment.

nodes.definition: Separation of a unit from background so it can be processed.
nodes.mathematical_form: D(x,b)=unit(x) where x is separated from background b
nodes.programming_contract: DistinctionUnit(unit_id, source_signal, raw_span, boundary, distinct_from, confidence, residuals)
nodes.linguistic_function: Segments lexical or semantic units before assignment.

nodes.definition: Assignment of type/reference/function to a distinguished unit.
nodes.programming_contract: DesignationUnit(designation_id, distinguished_unit_id, assigned_type, assigned_identity, assigned_reference, assigned_function, assignment_basis, confidence, residuals)
nodes.linguistic_function: Assigns grammatical-semantic role to segmented unit.

nodes.definition: Continuity of a designated unit across context, reference, and time.
nodes.mathematical_form: ID(x1)=ID(x2) under a valid continuity path
nodes.programming_contract: IdentityUnit(identity_id, mentions, reference_type, continuity_scope, temporal_scope, identity_basis, confidence, residuals)

nodes.definition: A concept that can be predicated of many instances.
nodes.programming_contract: UniversalConcept(concept_id, label, applies_to_many, necessary_features, accidental_features, domain, scope, residuals)

nodes.definition: A determinate singular referent not predicable of many the same way.
nodes.programming_contract: ParticularUnit(particular_id, reference, designation_id, time_scope, place_scope, identity_unit_id, residuals)
nodes.linguistic_function: Anchors claim subject to concrete referent.

nodes.definition: Scope where meaning, evidence, and judgment are valid.
nodes.mathematical_form: DM(x)=domain in which x is validly interpreted
nodes.programming_contract: DomainAssignment(domain_id, unit_id, domain, assignment_basis, allowed_evidence_types, forbidden_transfers, confidence, residuals)
nodes.linguistic_function: Prevents invalid transfer between linguistic, legal, empirical, and metaphorical scopes.

nodes.definition: Angle of predication such as potential/actual or literal/metaphorical.
nodes.linguistic_function: Distinguishes different predication modes that avoid false contradiction.

nodes.definition: Time bounds in which a claim remains valid.
nodes.programming_contract: TemporalScope(time_scope_id, claim_id, start, end, tense, validity, residuals)

nodes.definition: Epistemic rank of a claim (question, hypothesis, analysis, factual claim, certificate candidate).
nodes.linguistic_function: Aligns statement force before contradiction and final judgment checks.

nodes.definition: Checks contradiction only after same subject/predicate/meaning/domain/time/aspect/rank are resolved.
nodes.mathematical_form: Contradiction(P,¬P) ⇔ same_subject ∧ same_predicate ∧ same_meaning ∧ same_domain ∧ same_time ∧ same_aspect ∧ same_judgment_rank
nodes.programming_contract: ContradictionCheck(check_id, claim_a, claim_b, same_subject, same_predicate, same_meaning, same_domain, same_time, same_aspect, same_judgment_rank, contradiction, residuals)
nodes.linguistic_function: Prevents false contradiction detection across mismatched domains or scopes.

nodes.definition: Produces licensed relation candidates between units or between signal and prior information.
nodes.programming_contract: LinkCandidate(link_id, source_unit, target_unit, link_type, license, confidence_cap, can_raise_certainty, residuals)
nodes.linguistic_function: Builds candidate relations (reference, causality, entailment, metaphor) under governance.

nodes.definition: Aligns signal, reality, prior information, link candidates, first principles, and global rules to produce meaning.
nodes.programming_contract: InterpretationObject(interpretation_id, input_signal, reality_ref, prior_information_refs, link_candidates, first_principles_applied, global_rules_applied, meaning, scope, residuals)
nodes.linguistic_function: Stabilizes governed meaning from raw signal and relation candidates.

nodes.definition: Forms bounded concept representation without final proof judgment.
nodes.programming_contract: ConceptionObject(conception_id, interpreted_meaning, concept_type, boundaries, examples, counterexamples, residuals)
nodes.linguistic_function: Produces concept structure ready for governed judgment.

nodes.definition: Governed final status assignment after evidence, proof object, governance gate, and reverse trace checks.
nodes.programming_contract: JudgmentObject(judgment_id, claim_id, final_judgment, evidence_refs, residuals, reverse_trace, proof_object, governance_gate)
nodes.linguistic_function: Emits final epistemic status for claim governance.
